name: Cloudkill

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 PHB; compare every number with the book before setting checked_against.

summary: A 20-foot poison fog: Con save, 5d8 Poison (half on a success), and it drifts away from you.
text: Creatures save when it appears, when it moves onto them, when they enter it and when they end a turn in it, once per turn. The fog is Heavily Obscured and moves 10 ft away from you at the start of each of your turns.
